description: Calculates shipments and returns a report with the basic content ISO 14083 asks for at the level of transport services (GLEC v3.3 Section 2 Ch.1): coverage and failures, totals split into TTW and WTT, intensity, per mode and hub type, energy carriers, data quality (primary/modelled/default shares, sources, models), distance adjustments, and notes. Returned as Markdown and as structured data.

add_road_legs.description: Add road legs where the legs don't join up (gaps over 5 km), and to a port or terminal when a sea, rail or river leg starts or ends off its network (default true). Added legs are marked in the result.

declare_iso.description: Add the ISO 14083:2023 conformity statement. Only when the user explicitly confirms that their data collection and boundaries conform.

period_from.description: Start of the period covered, YYYY-MM-DD

period_to.description: End of the period covered, YYYY-MM-DD

reference.description: Where supporting information can be found

scope3_category.description: GHG Protocol scope 3 category of this transport for the user's company: 4 if it pays for the transport (inbound or outbound), 9 for its sold products moved by transport it doesn't pay for. Ask; leave out if unknown.

shipments.description: The shipments. Without an API key the public service takes up to 100 per call; with one, up to 10,000.

add_road_legs.description: Add road legs where the legs don't join up (gaps over 5 km), and to a port or terminal when a sea, rail or river leg starts or ends off its network (default true). Added legs are marked in the result.

cargo_type.description: Optional, GLEC v3.3 cargo or load category: container, temperature_controlled, light, heavy, or for European rail cars, chemicals, coal_steel, building_materials, manufactured_products, cereals, truck_trailer_on_train, trailer_on_train. Picks GLEC's value for it where GLEC has one for the leg's vehicle; otherwise the vehicle's own value (the leg's note says which).

container_load.description: With teu, instead of teu_net_tonnes: average (10 t), light (6 t) or heavy (14.5 t) per TEU, from the GLEC Framework

hubs.description: Hub stops: hub_type transshipment, storage_transshipment, warehouse or liquid_bulk_terminal (add _mixed for ambient and temperature-controlled sites), per tonne; intermodal_terminal or intermodal_terminal_temperature_controlled, per container (give containers). GLEC v3.3 Table 3.

legs.description: The legs in order, from where the shipper hands the goods over to where the consignee receives them.

items.description: One transport movement with one mode and vehicle type (an ISO 14083 transport chain element).

country.description: With energy_kwh_per_tkm: ISO 3166 alpha-3 country whose grid supplies the electricity, e.g. DEU

distance_km.description: The distance, if known. When given, it is used as is and not routed; say what kind it is with distance_type. Leave it out to route from the coordinates (preferred).

distance_type.description: Kind of distance_km: sfd = shortest feasible route, gcd = great circle, actual = actually travelled (e.g. odometer). Decides the distance adjustment factor (DAF) applied.

empty_trip_factor.description: Trucks, with load_tonnes or load_factor: empty km driven per loaded km (e.g. 0.3).

energy_kwh_per_tkm.description: Electric trains or trucks: electricity per tonne-km (the operator's figure; no default), with country.

from.description: A place: coordinates (lat and lon, optionally name), or a code instead. Use find_places to look up coordinates or codes for a place name.

code.description: Instead of lat/lon: a UN/LOCODE (e.g. NLRTM for Rotterdam) or IATA airport code (e.g. CPH)

name.description: Label for the place, shown in results

fuel.description: Measured fuel for the vehicle trip this leg is part of (primary data).

amount.description: Amount in the fuel's unit (litres for the aliases)

fuel.description: Fuel id or alias: diesel, petrol, hvo, marine_gas_oil, marine_fuel_oil, jet_fuel (per litre), electricity/<ISO3 country> (kWh), or others from list_vehicle_types with include_fuels

vehicle_tonne_km.description: Total tonne-km of the whole trip, to give this shipment its share of the fuel. Leave out if the trip carried only this shipment.

load_factor.description: Trucks: load as a share (0-1) of the load model's payload, DESNZ's average full load (17.9 t for an articulated truck over 33 t), NOT of the truck's rated payload as in GLEC or EcoTransIT. Give load_tonnes or load_factor, not both.

load_tonnes.description: Trucks: the tonnes on the truck (all cargo, averaged over the loaded km), which switches the leg to the load model. Prefer this over load_factor when the weight is known.

repositioning_km.description: Trucks: km driven empty for this trip (to the pickup or back), shared over the truck's load like empty running. Without a load, the shipment is taken as the whole load.

to.description: A place: coordinates (lat and lon, optionally name), or a code instead. Use find_places to look up coordinates or codes for a place name.

code.description: Instead of lat/lon: a UN/LOCODE (e.g. NLRTM for Rotterdam) or IATA airport code (e.g. CPH)

name.description: Label for the place, shown in results

vehicle_type.description: A short alias or a full id from list_vehicle_types. Common: road hgv (average truck), hgv_artic_33t (articulated truck over 33 t, a 40 t semitrailer), hgv_rigid, van; rail freight_train; sea container_ship (short-sea factor under 2,000 km, deep-sea from 2,000 km), bulk_carrier, general_cargo, roro, ropax; air air_freight; inland_waterway barge, container_barge.

teu.description: Containers in TEU, instead of weight_kg; with teu_net_tonnes, or alone for GLEC's average of 10 t per TEU

teu_net_tonnes.description: With teu: net cargo tonnes per TEU (container tare is not added)

weight_kg.description: Cargo weight in kg (or give teu instead)

name: emissions_report
title: Emissions report over many shipments
